nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri 2 Tray App
nodes.rationale: Local app on user's computer (Windows, macOS) that serves as library engine and disk for the browser. When running, it is the library's engine and the website is its screen.

nodes.label: Quality Verdicts: Spectroscopic Analysis
nodes.rationale: Judges hi-res by ultrasonic content (>24 kHz above digital silence). Steep top end with content that follows music and no frequent drop-outs = lossless mastering lowpass. Implemented in src/core/audio/verdict.ts.

nodes.label: Duplicate Detection: Fingerprints & Names
nodes.rationale: Three tiers: fingerprints (same recording), artist+title with lengths within 3s (probable), user confirmation. Only copies of same version count. Best copy is genuine then lossless then main folder then resolution.

nodes.label: GLUE Folder: JSON Files Store
nodes.rationale: User's data in JSON files, not database (ADR 0009). Contains mco.json, profiles, collections, tracks, analysis, lists, sources, events, dupes, backups, cloud sync.

nodes.label: Local Link: GLUE Home API Server
nodes.rationale: HTTP server at 127.0.0.1:47400-47409. Routes: /hello, /connect (token handoff), /fs/* (disk operations), /cache (analyses), /rpc (engine), /lease, /attach, /incoming, /dock, /folders.

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud: Cloudflare Worker & D1
nodes.rationale: Optional account service. Never holds music, only collections, profiles, devices. Cloudflare Worker with D1 for data and Durable Object for signaling and WebRTC relay.

nodes.label: Profiles: Artist Aliases
nodes.rationale: Artist alias with id, name, color, BPM range. Signed in, account keeps list (union of every device's). One GLUE folder has one library one alias opens. Profiles are every device's.

nodes.label: Collections: Shared Form & Sync
nodes.rationale: Signed in with cloud sync on, every collection is account's. Shared form has members (computer->library folder), songs with copies per computer. Same file on two computers = one song with copy on each.

nodes.label: Background Analysis: Worker Pool
nodes.rationale: Pool in src/lib/pool.ts, in worker threads or GLUE Home. Makes summary (verdict, tier, bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key), details, fingerprint, mini spectrogram, waveform. Versions: ANALYSIS_VERSION 3, VERDICT_VERSION 8.

nodes.label: WebRTC: P2P Song Streaming
nodes.rationale: Streams songs to other devices over WebRTC data channels, signaled through GLUE Cloud. TURN relay for connections that can't be direct. Bounded with 30s timeouts and request gates.

nodes.label: Website: Svelte App on GitHub Pages
nodes.rationale: Svelte 5 + TypeScript app at https://joaopmanso.github.io/glue/. Works offline, without account. Routes: #/ library, #/track/<id>, #/events, #/analyze, #/admin.

nodes.label: Track: Song Data Model
nodes.rationale: Song with status (linked, missing, unlinked), rootId+relPath (music folder placement), importPath (DJ library), fileKey (copies), sources (DJ libraries), tags, info, rating, prep (Prepare tab: bpm, grid, cues), unwritten (edits).

nodes.label: Music Folders: Roots
nodes.rationale: Handles live in IndexedDB (handleKey) or GLUE Home finds them. Incoming folder is hidden root (INCOMING_ROOT) shown as TO BE SORTED. Network folders that disconnect wait, not gone.

nodes.label: Cloud Sync: Shared Collections Engine
nodes.rationale: src/store/shared/engine.ts. GLUE Cloud keeps snapshot (shared_files) and log (shared_log). merge3 per field, computer's own side wins. Clashes wait in box. Files told as written, read again even if sync fails.

nodes.label: Durable Object: Signaling & Presence
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare Durable Object for presence and broadcasts to account's devices (shared, including gone, profiles), plus WebRTC signals. TURN relay credentials from /v1/turn.

nodes.label: ANALYSIS_VERSION 3, VERDICT_VERSION 8
nodes.rationale: Versions for analysis and verdict (stored, recheckVerdicts on open). Rule change bumps version. Held to TypeScript results.
